g.text: after extensive research, I've determined which beverage to recommend u try ^_^
sweet and salty. best of both worlds! just the way u like it
You've really done your research. I'm flattered. I'll have to try one.
Is that so? I'd like to try it. We should go out and get some together.
Look, this whole manic pixie dream girl act is cute and all, but I don't need it in my life.
it's as dark and rich as ur beautiful soul
I doooubt we'll find a trendy cafe in Höllvania...
its flavor profile straddles earthy and spicy much like how u straddle past and future!
but let's plan for the future!
If we're meeting in 1999, it's the past to me.
I guess, personally speaking, it's in both our futures.
Only an Entrati could ever make sense of this.
but for u personally, it'd still be in ur future, right?
even though ur coming to the past?
Yeah, we'll drive ourselves crazy trying to make sense of time travel.
Let's just say going to the past is in my future.
We can just focus on our cafe date instead.
just like a certain doktor I know ^_^
It's best if we just focus on our cafe date.
... tell me u aren't about to stand up for the doktor of my comic book nightmares
I'll just look forward to our cafe date
past, present, future. whenever that trendy cafe finds us, our date there will be awesome <3
u'd think i'd be better at spotting sarcasm
past, present, future. whenever that trendy cafe finds us, our date there will be awesome <3
